symptoms.symptom: Refrigerator does not operate

causes.label: Refrigerator in defrost cycle.
remedies: Wait about 30 minutes for defrost cycle to end.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Refrigerator in defrost cycle."

causes.label: Control in 0 (off) position.
remedies: Move the control to a temperature setting.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Control in 0 (off) position."

causes.label: Refrigerator is unplugged.
remedies: Push the plug completely into the outlet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Refrigerator is unplugged."

causes.label: The fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped.
remedies: Replace fuse or reset the breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "The fuse is blown/circuit breaker is tripped."

symptoms.symptom: Vibration or rattling (slight vibration is normal)

causes.label: Leveling legs need adjusting.
remedies: See Level the Refrigerator.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Leveling legs need adjusting."

symptoms.symptom: Motor operates for long periods or cycles on and off frequently. (Modern refrigerators with more storage space and a larger freezer require more operating time. They start and stop often to maintain even temperatures.)

causes.label: Normal when refrigerator is first plugged in.
remedies: Wait 24 hours for the refrigerator to completely cool down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Normal when refrigerator is first plugged in."

causes.label: Often occurs when large amounts of food are placed in refrigerator.
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Often occurs when large amounts of food are placed in refrigerator."

causes.label: Door left open.
remedies: Check to see if package is holding door open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Door left open."

causes.label: Hot weather or frequent door openings.
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Hot weather or frequent door openings."

causes.label: Temperature control set at the coldest setting.
remedies: See About the controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Temperature control set at the coldest setting."

causes.label: TurboCool function has been activated.
remedies: This is normal when the TurboCool function is activated.
See About TurboCool for more information.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "TurboCool function has been activated."

symptoms.symptom: Refrigerator or freezer compartment too warm

causes.label: Temperature controls not set cold enough.
remedies: See About the controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Temperature controls not set cold enough."

causes.label: Warm weather or frequent door openings.
remedies: Set the temperature control one step colder.
See About the controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Warm weather or frequent door openings."

causes.label: Door left open.
remedies: Check to see if package is holding door open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Door left open."

symptoms.symptom: Frost or ice crystals on frozen food (frost within package is normal)

causes.label: Door left open.
remedies: Check to see if package is holding door open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Door left open."

causes.label: Door openings too frequent or too long.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Door openings too frequent or too long."

symptoms.symptom: Frequent “buzzing” sound

causes.label: Icemaker power switch is in the I (on) position, but the water supply to the refrigerator has not been connected.
remedies: Set the power switch to the 0 (off) position.
Keeping it in the I (on) position will damage the water valve.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Icemaker power switch is in the I (on) position, but the water supply to the refrigerator has not been connected."

symptoms.symptom: Small or hollow cubes

causes.label: Water filter clogged.
remedies: Replace filter cartridge with new cartridge or with plug.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Water filter clogged."

symptoms.symptom: Automatic icemaker (on some models) does not work

causes.label: Icemaker power switch is not on.
remedies: Set the power switch to the I (on) position.
The icemaker power light will turn green when the freezer light switch is pressed in or when the freezer door is closed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Icemaker power switch is not on."

causes.label: Water supply turned off or not connected.
remedies: See Installing the water line.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Water supply turned off or not connected."

causes.label: Freezer compartment too warm.
remedies: Wait 24 hours for the refrigerator to completely cool down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Freezer compartment too warm."

causes.label: Piled up cubes in the storage bin cause the icemaker to shut off.
remedies: Level cubes by hand.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Piled up cubes in the storage bin cause the icemaker to shut off."

causes.label: Ice cubes stuck in icemaker. (Green power light on icemaker blinking.)
remedies: Turn off the icemaker, remove cubes and turn the icemaker back on.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Ice cubes stuck in icemaker. (Green power light on icemaker blinking.)"

causes.label: Icemaker light is not lit.
remedies: This is normal when the freezer door is open.
The icemaker power light will turn green when the freezer light switch is pressed in or when the freezer door is closed.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 37: "Icemaker light is not lit."

symptoms.symptom: Ice cubes have odor/taste

causes.label: Food transmitting odor/taste to ice cubes.
remedies: Wrap foods well.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Food transmitting odor/taste to ice cubes."

causes.label: Interior of refrigerator needs cleaning.
remedies: See Care and cleaning. •Keep an open box of baking soda in the refrigerator; replace every three months.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Interior of refrigerator needs cleaning."

symptoms.symptom: Slow ice cube freezing

causes.label: Door left open.
remedies: Check to see if package is holding door open.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Door left open."

causes.label: Freezer control not set cold enough.
remedies: See About the controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Freezer control not set cold enough."

symptoms.symptom: Refrigerator has odor

causes.label: Foods transmitting odor to refrigerator.
remedies: Foods with strong odors should be tightly wrapped.
Keep an open box of baking soda in the refrigerator; replace every three months.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Foods transmitting odor to refrigerator."

causes.label: Interior needs cleaning.
remedies: See Care and cleaning.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Interior needs cleaning."

symptoms.symptom: Moisture forms on outside of refrigerator

causes.label: Not unusual during periods of high humidity.
remedies: Wipe surface dry and reset the refrigerator control one setting colder.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Not unusual during periods of high humidity."

symptoms.symptom: Moisture collects inside (in humid weather, air carries moisture into refrigerator when doors are opened)

causes.label: Too frequent or too long door openings.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Too frequent or too long door openings."

symptoms.symptom: Refrigerator or freezer compartment light does not work

causes.label: No power at outlet.
remedies: Replace fuse or reset the breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "No power at outlet."

causes.label: Light bulb burned out or loose.
remedies: See Replacing the light bulbs.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Light bulb burned out or loose."

symptoms.symptom: Door/drawer does not close by itself

causes.label: Leveling legs need adjusting.
remedies: See Installing the Refrigerator.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Leveling legs need adjusting."

symptoms.symptom: Freezer door/drawer pops open when refrigerator door is closed

causes.label: This is normal if, after popping open, the freezer door/drawer closed on its own.
remedies: This indicates that there is a good seal on the freezer door/drawer.
If the freezer door/drawer does not automatically close after popping open, then see the Problem: Door/drawer does not close by itself, above.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "This is normal if, after popping open, the freezer door/drawer closed on its own."

symptoms.symptom: Hot air from bottom of refrigerator

causes.label: Normal air flow cooling motor. In the refrigeration process, it is normal that heat be expelled in the area under the refrigerator.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Normal air flow cooling motor. In the refrigeration process, it is normal that heat be expelled in the area under the refrigerator."

causes.label: Some floor coverings will discolor at these normal and safe temperatures.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Some floor coverings will discolor at these normal and safe temperatures."

symptoms.symptom: Food freezing in the refrigerator

causes.label: Food too close to the air vent at the back of the refrigerator.
remedies: Move the food away from the air vent.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Food too close to the air vent at the back of the refrigerator."

causes.label: Refrigerator control is set too cold.
remedies: Move the refrigerator control to a warmer temperature setting one increment at a time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Refrigerator control is set too cold."

symptoms.symptom: Orange glow in the freezer

causes.label: Defrost heater is on.
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 38: "Defrost heater is on."

symptoms.symptom: Water has poor taste/odor

causes.label: Water dispenser has not been used for a long time.
remedies: Dispense water until all water in system is replenished.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Water dispenser has not been used for a long time."

symptoms.symptom: Water in first glass is warm

causes.label: Normal when refrigerator is first installed.
remedies: Wait 24 hours for the refrigerator to completely cool down.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Normal when refrigerator is first installed."

causes.label: Water dispenser has not been used for a long time.
remedies: Dispense water until all water is system is replenished.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Water dispenser has not been used for a long time."

causes.label: Water system has been drained.
remedies: Allow several hours for replenished supply to chill.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Water system has been drained."

symptoms.symptom: Water dispenser does not work

causes.label: Water supply line turned off or not connected.
remedies: See Installing the water line.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Water supply line turned off or not connected."

causes.label: Water filter clogged.
remedies: Replace filter cartridge or remove filter and install plug.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Water filter clogged."

causes.label: Air may be trapped in the water system.
remedies: Press the dispenser arm for at least 2 minutes.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Air may be trapped in the water system."

causes.label: Water in reservoir is frozen because the controls are set too cold.
remedies: Set the refrigerator control to a warmer setting and wait 24 hours.
If water does not dispense after 24 hours, call for service.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Water in reservoir is frozen because the controls are set too cold."

symptoms.symptom: Water spurting from dispenser

causes.label: Newly-installed filter cartridge.
remedies: Run water from the dispenser for 3 minutes (about 11⁄2 gallons).
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Newly-installed filter cartridge."

symptoms.symptom: No water or ice cube production

causes.label: Supply line or shutoff valve is clogged.
remedies: Call a plumber.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Supply line or shutoff valve is clogged."

causes.label: Water filter clogged.
remedies: Replace filter cartridge or remove filter and install plug.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Water filter clogged."

causes.label: Filter cartridge not properly installed.
remedies: Remove and reinstall filter cartridge, being certain that it locks into place.
The blade on the end of the cartridge should be positioned vertically.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Filter cartridge not properly installed."

symptoms.symptom: Water is leaking from dispenser

causes.label: Glass not being held under the dispenser long enough after button is released.
remedies: Hold the glass underneath the dispenser for 2–3 seconds after releasing the dispenser button.
Water may continue to dispense after the button is released.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Glass not being held under the dispenser long enough after button is released."

causes.label: Air may be present in the water line system, causing water to drip after being dispensed.
remedies: Dispense water for at least 2 minutes to remove air from system.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 39: "Air may be present in the water line system, causing water to drip after being dispensed."

symptoms.symptom: My display is showing

causes.label: TurboCool function is activated.
remedies: See About TurboCool for more information.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 40: "TurboCool function is activated."

symptoms.symptom: Water filter indicator light changed color

causes.label: This is normal.
remedies: See About the water filter for more information.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 40: "This is normal."

symptoms.symptom: Water filter indicator light remains red even after replacing the water filter

causes.label: Water filter indicator must be reset.
remedies: Press and hold the RESET WATER FILTER pad for 3 seconds.
See About the water filter for more information.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 40: "Water filter indicator must be reset."

symptoms.symptom: Water filter indicator light is not lit

causes.label: This is normal. This light will turn orange to tell you that you need to replace the filter soon.
remedies: See About the water filter for more information.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 40: "This is normal. This light will turn orange to tell you that you need to replace the filter soon."

causes.label: The filter cartridge should be replaced when the replacement indicator light turns red.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 40: "The filter cartridge should be replaced when the replacement indicator light turns red."

symptoms.symptom: Handle is loose / handle has a gap

causes.label: Handle needs adjusting.
remedies: See Attach the Fresh Food handle and Attach the Freezer handle sections for detailed instructions.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 40: "Handle needs adjusting."

symptoms.symptom: Refrigerator beeping

causes.label: This is the door alarm.
remedies: Close door.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 40: "This is the door alarm."
